judge.rationale: The candidate diff contains no implementation code whatsoever, only adding a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, an acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and brief additions to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`. None of the required production files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `src/index.ts`, etc.) were modified. Consequently, the new acceptance tests will fail to compile or fail at runtime because `history` options, `list_conversations` validation, and `conversation_list` handling do not exist. Furthermore, almost all acceptance criteria—including `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, `StoreCannotList`, error handling, and concurrency tests—are completely missing.
